scientific_role: fresh real-system validation of calibration-only selective promotion of EOG contextual representation

selection_boundary.selection_basis: The published article reports wild boar as the most detected non-human mammal: 2580 individual detections, present at 67 locations and all 9 arrays.

published_response_semantics_frozen_befo.positive_definition: eligible active deployment-ISO-week has at least one sequence whose genus is Sus and species is scrofa
published_response_semantics_frozen_befo.negative_definition: eligible active deployment-ISO-week has no such sequence; interpreted as no recorded detection under camera effort, not biological absence

prospective_temporal_split_rule.week_enumeration: derive all unique ISO weeks intersecting deployment start-end intervals using deployment payload only

geometry_world_rule.four_local_thresholds: 20th, 40th, 60th, and 80th percentiles of positive pairwise inter-node distances, computed deployment-only and frozen before response access

selective_promotion_rule.promotion: promote contextual Layer B only if frozen inner-validation macro binary log loss is strictly lower than baseline-only; otherwise retain baseline-only
selective_promotion_rule.selected_arm_refit: refit selected arm on inner_train plus inner_validation under the same frozen learner, then score outer once

if_stage0_stop: terminal pre-response STOP; no source, target, split, transport or geometry rescue within this attempt
